sentences.en: Though God may forgive, man is not therefore to forget.
sentences.zh: 虽然上帝可能会宽恕，但人类因此不应遗忘。

sentences.en: He was very rich, and therefore could buy a mansion.
sentences.zh: 他非常富有，因此可以买一栋豪宅。

sentences.en: He was judged sane and was therefore chargeable with murder.
sentences.zh: 他被判定为精神正常，因此对谋杀案负有责任。
